headlines.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) on Nov. 9

headlines.title: NXP Semiconductors (NXPI) Sees $10.4 Million in Net ETF Buying on Nov. 5

headlines.title: JPMorgan Global Select Equity ETF (JGLO) Adds Microsoft and NXP on Oct. 29
headlines.summary: The fund bought $18.9 million of Microsoft and $6.6 million of NXP Semiconductors while selling $22.0 million of Alphabet and $21.0 million of Apple.

headlines.title: Semtech Stock Plunges 34% in 3 Months: Should You Buy the Dip?
headlines.summary: SMTC shares plunge 34% in three months, but strong AI data center demand, 1.6T growth and rising LoRa adoption make the stock an attractive buy.

headlines.title: iShares PHLX SOX Semiconductor (SOXX) Buys $394.7 Million More AMD on Nov. 9
headlines.summary: The fund added $394.7 million of AMD and $315.3 million of Broadcom, with $3.66 billion in net buying across 29 increased positions.

description: NXP Semiconductors N.V. provides semiconductor products in the United States, Germany, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, Singapore, the Netherlands, Mainland China, Hong Kong, and internationally. The company's product portfolio includes microcontrollers; application processors; communication processors; wireless connectivity solutions, such as near field communications, ultra-wideband, Bluetooth low-energy, Zigbee, Thread, and Wi-Fi and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth integrated SoCs; analog and interface products; radio frequency devices, and security controllers, as well as semiconductor-based environmental and inertial sensors, including pressure, inertial, magnetic, and gyroscopic sensors. Its products are used in various applications, including automotive, industrial and Internet of Things, mobile, and communication infrastructure. The company markets its products to direct sales offices and independent distributors. NXP Semiconductors N.V. has a strategic partnership with Volkswagen AG to advance automotive semiconductor technology. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands.
